title: Data Lake Medallion Pipeline
description: Runnable Bronze/Silver/Gold medallion pipeline: a pandas+pyarrow version that runs locally plus the Spark and Delta Lake jobs from the guide's e-commerce scenario, with hive-style partitioning.
